paper_title: STREAM: Stress and Thermal Aware Reliability Management for 3-D ICs

scenario.description: Transient maximum temperature of the two-layer 3D IC under a synthetic workload with three cool phases and two hot phases. STREAM (ANN stress model, lifetime banking, lifetime MPC) is compared with the existing method [21] and with free run (no reliability management). The paper reports free-run temperature reaching about 110 C and the existing method holding it below the 90 C threshold. STREAM tolerates threshold violations while the lifetime deposit (Fig. 14b) is positive.
scenario.architecture: Two-layer 3D IC microprocessor with 32 identical Alpha 21264 cores (16 per layer) and 144 TSVs, 10 mm x 10 mm x 0.3 mm. TSV radii are ri=20 um and ro=24 um, with a Cu-filled TSV and SiO2 liner. Thermal model from HotSpot with 3D extension, ambient 20 C, DVFS with 19 voltage/frequency levels.
scenario.workload: Synthetic workload emulating user application behavior (three cool phases, two hot phases) over about 400 s. Power traces for SPEC CPU2006 are generated with Wattch, but the synthetic trace is not tabulated.
scenario.operating_point: Threshold temperature 90 C, ambient 20 C, maximum frequency 2.0 GHz. Free-run maximum temperature about 110 C, read from Fig. 14a. Lifetime deposit reaches zero at about 240 s in Fig. 14b.

original_setup.solver: HotSpot compact RC thermal model with 3D extension (G, C, Bc matrices, 92x92, 92x92 and 92x32), discretized with backward Euler. COMSOL 5.0 provides the golden TSV stress data. Control and reliability code is in MATLAB R2016b (pdf p.3, p.10, p.11).
original_setup.optimizer: Lifetime MPC: closed-form unconstrained least-squares tracking of a target temperature distribution, dP = (Phi^T Phi)^-1 Phi^T (Ytg - V That), with a lookup-table target temperature estimator. The ANN stress model is trained by RPROP backpropagation (pdf p.5, p.6, p.9).
original_setup.controller: STREAM: ANN stress model, lifetime estimator with lifetime banking (LTDP), and lifetime MPC. The MPC power suggestion is realized through DVFS with 19 voltage/frequency levels. A 0.1 s management period was used for the performance experiments and 1 s for the transient-tracking experiment (pdf p.9-12).
original_setup.benchmark: Synthetic workload with three cool phases and two hot phases over about 400 s, on a two-layer 3D IC with 32 Alpha 21264 cores, 144 TSVs and a 10x10x0.3 mm chip. STREAM is compared with the existing method [21] and a free run without management (Fig. 14a/14b, pdf p.12-13). The synthetic power trace itself is not tabulated.

thermal_observable.location: Maximum on-chip temperature of the two-layer 3D IC in Fig. 14a. The 110 degC value is the free-run case, read from the text. The existing method is held below the 90 degC threshold.
thermal_observable.aggregation: Maximum temperature across the chip at each time instant, as a transient over about 400 s. The 110 degC is the approximate free-run peak and is not an exact tabulated value.

physical_mismatches.reason: The paper models a two-layer 3D IC with TSVs, TSV-induced thermomechanical stress and inter-layer coupling. A Studio 2D single-layer model cannot represent the vertical stacking, TSV heat paths or stress.
The observable is a transient maximum temperature under a time-varying synthetic workload with DVFS feedback. A steady-state 2D model cannot reproduce it.

The result depends on closed-loop lifetime MPC with lifetime banking and DVFS actuation. This controller, with its ANN stress model, MTTF reliability models (thermal cycling and stress migration) and LTDP lifetime deposit, has no counterpart in a plain thermal solver.
The optimizer is a model predictive controller plus RPROP ANN training, not a floorplan or placement optimizer. The paper provides no placement coordinates for an optimization comparison.
The paper uses HotSpot 3D with a 92-node compact model, Wattch power traces, and COMSOL for stress. The solver, grid and package model differ from the Studio solver.

missing_inputs: No paper-linked assets, repositories or supplementary data were found (artifact search found no links). The packet contains no pinned assets.
No per-core or per-block x_m, y_m, width_m, height_m. Only the total chip size (10 mm x 10 mm x 0.3 mm) and the Fig. 4a layout are given. Alpha 21264 core dimensions are not tabulated.
No same-scenario per-block power rows (name and watts) for the synthetic workload. The Wattch power traces and the synthetic trace are not provided, and total power is not published.

No numeric time series for Fig. 14a or Fig. 14b. The 110 degC and 90 degC values come from the text, and the 240 s lifetime deposit exhaustion is read from the figure, so any further values would need digitizing with uncertainty.
No HotSpot 3D configuration: layer thicknesses and materials, TSV placement coordinates, interface materials, package, spreader and heat sink parameters, or convection boundary conditions.
No reliability model constants (A0, qc, sigma0, B0, Ea, na), no MTTFth design target value, and no ANN weights or MPC horizons (Np, Nc).
The Studio package and material assumptions were not supplied in the packet and are not recorded.
